metadata.document_title: The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

article.title: Delegation of powers.
article.content: The Commissioner may, by notification, direct that subject to such conditions, if any, as may be specified in the notification, any power exercisable by any authority or officer under this Act may be exercisable also by another authority or officer as may be specified in such notification.
article.html:
167Delegation of powers.

Section 167 · Chapter XXI · page 121 of the Act

The Commissioner may, by notification, direct that subject to such conditions, if any, as may be specified in the notification, any power exercisable by any authority or officer under this Act may be exercisable also by another authority or officer as may be specified in such notification.
